verdict.rationale: Airwallex has a Bills API for creating/managing vendor invoices and AgentOS for AI agents to act on the account, but no evidence describes AI reading/parsing incoming bill documents (OCR/extraction) to auto-populate payment details for user review — the Bills API appears to require structured input rather than document ingestion. Missing for 10: AI-driven document parsing/extraction from bill images or PDFs, and a review/approval UI step populated from that extraction.
